real.h: Accused killer in {} offers to plead guilty for a cheesesteak, fries and a Pepsi
real.clue: US city on a Florida bay; a Philly cheesesteak is a US-wide order

real.h: Detective in {} is fired after allegedly pointing a gun at a colleague who was heating fish
real.clue: US beach resort town; police arrest warrant released by the state law enforcement agency

real.h: Government bill in {} would let cars on international wanted lists be registered
real.clue: Russian parliament (State Duma) bill; "unfriendly countries" wording = Russia

fake.h: Surf lifesavers at a beach in {} reach a man who drifted 2.4 km out on an inflatable pizza slice
fake.tell: The oddly specific float and distance read like a scripted story rather than a news report.

fake.h: Pub in {} runs out of pints on a Tuesday after 312 regulars turn up for a quiz about the pub's own history
fake.tell: An unlikely coincidence: hundreds arriving for a niche quiz on a quiet weeknight.

fake.h: Ski resort in {} reopens lift after a marmot chewed through its control cable in January
fake.tell: Marmots hibernate in January, so the animal would not be gnawing cables then.

fake.h: Burglar in {} tunnels 16 metres under a bakery to reach a till holding only 9 euros
fake.tell: Digging a long tunnel for a nearly empty till is too much effort to be believable.

fake.h: Reindeer block the main road into {} for three hours, delaying 52 school buses
fake.tell: A herd crossing happening to hit exactly the school-bus run is a suspicious coincidence.
fake.hint: home of the Loch Ness Monster

fake.h: Ferry crossing a fjord near {} turns back as captain leaves lunch ashore, delaying 63 passengers
fake.tell: A tidy cause and effect: no crew would turn a ferry round for a forgotten lunch.

fake.h: Outdoor pool in {} freezes over for the first time since 1974, trapping a pedalo
fake.tell: Pedalos belong on lakes and seas, not in pools, which is a detail slightly off.
fake.hint: host of the first modern Olympics

fake.h: Moose wanders into a junior hockey rink in {}, play resumes after 19 minutes
fake.tell: Too tidy and quick: a moose indoors would stop a game far longer.

fake.h: Taxi driver in {} returns a bag holding 14,800 rand to a passenger, then learns it was his own
fake.tell: An over-neat coincidence: nobody forgets their own bag in their own cab.
fake.hint: where Sam Nujoma became first president

fake.h: Cheese warehouse in {} loses 29 wheels of Gouda; thieves abandon the van after it runs out of diesel
fake.tell: The cause and effect is too tidy, and the thieves' failure arrives like a punchline.

fake.h: Shire in {} bans backyard cricket after 17 balls land in neighbours' pools; fine set at A$220
fake.tell: Shires don't ban a sport outright over a number of balls; fines target noise or nuisance.

fake.h: Vending machine in {} serves only hot canned drinks for 12 days in August; owner refunds 3,900 yen
fake.tell: A thermostat fault wouldn't heat every can in summer, and owners rarely refund a whole machine's sales.

fake.h: Bus driver in {} halts route for 40 minutes to let 53 turkeys cross, passengers applaud
fake.tell: Passengers applauding a delay is a movie-style detail that real commuters rarely deliver.

fake.h: Reindeer herd strolls through beach resort in {} as temperatures hit 38C; lifeguards hand out carrots
fake.tell: Reindeer are Arctic animals and wouldn't be wandering a hot beach resort.

fake.h: Burglar arrested by same constable who caught his father 22 years ago, on same street with same stolen bicycle in {}
fake.tell: The coincidence stacks too many matching details to be believable.
fake.hint: home of the Book of Kells

fake.h: Thief steals 63 garden gnomes from allotments in {}, leaves note saying 'they looked lonely' and €20
fake.tell: A thief leaving a sentimental note and paying money is a movie-style flourish.

fake.h: Monsoon floods in {} carry 41 plastic chairs from a wedding hall to a temple; priest accepts them as a donation
fake.tell: Floodwater delivering exactly the thing a priest can gracefully accept is too tidy.
fake.hint: the home of street-food pad thai
